mira: Hey — new user report: the sampleapp onboarding fails when using the Node SDK. REST curl works fine. Error in logs: `HandshakeError: timeout after 10s`. Repro steps in the thread.
jamal: can you paste the logs + exact command you used?
mira: sure
mira: ```
# reproduce
node sampleapp.js --env=staging
# snippet
Error: HandshakeError: timeout after 10s
    at Client._handshake (node_modules/redwood-sdk/lib/auth.js:78:15)
``` 
mira: curl to the same endpoint with the same API key succeeds instantly.
alex: interesting — looks like SDK is doing a short internal handshake timeout before it even sends the token. Do we have telemetry showing SDK vs REST latencies?
ci-bot: [CI] e2e/onboard-sampleapp (node) failed on run 2026-03-22T14:12:03Z — logs uploaded: https://ci.redwood.internal/logs/1978887777
jamal: I dug into client code — default `connectTimeoutMs` is 10000 in node SDK. REST path uses fetch with no explicit connect timeout (effectively much larger). So SDK gives up earlier.
tess: that's subtle. Also saw SDK disables retries on handshake errors; fetch path retries auth on 401 and replays request.
mira: so production users might see failures during cold starts or marginal networks.
sam: quick fix: expose handshake timeout option in SDK and align default to 30s. I'll open a PR.
sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482
alex: we should also add telemetry metric `sdk.handshake_duration_ms` and tag by runtime and region so we can alert on regressions.
jamal: agree. Action items: 1) SDK PR to bump default to 30s + config (owner: sam) 2) add handshake telemetry (owner: alex) 3) add a unit/e2e test that simulates slow auth handshake in CI (owner: mira) 4) doc note in onboarding guide about SDK timeout (owner: tess)
mira: thanks — I'll reproduce after the PR lands and update the sampleapp quickstart if needed. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy queued for sdk/main build 6543 — includes handshake-timeout flag (no deploy until CI passes)
mira: ping @sam for ETA
sam: aiming to open the PR by EOD today and have CI green tomorrow. :eyes:
alex: also add a changelog entry for breaking change if someone relied on 10s default.
mira: noted. closing loop once sampleapp quickstart verified.
